history.summary: A 1,615 sqft '2BR' in freehold East Coast at $1,455 psf — the bedroom/size mismatch flags an oversized or mis-classified unit, and the low PSF reflects size, not a bargain. Weak 1.6%/yr URA appreciation on just 15 txns and a $2.35M quantum for a 2BR-labelled unit make this a hard pass on investment metrics.
history.rating_rationale: A 1,615 sqft 2BR is anomalous — either mis-listed or a very inefficient layout — and the $1,455 psf only looks cheap because of the bloated floor area; the $1,769.5 median tells the real story. URA appreciation is a poor 1.6%/yr on a thin 15-txn series, and Elliot is a small boutique block with shallow liquidity (record 174-247 reflects weak arena performance). Freehold + Siglap MRT/East Coast lifestyle are the only redeeming features.
red_flags: Bedroom/sqft mismatch — 1,615 sqft for a '2BR' (mis-classification or inefficient layout)
Weak 1.6%/yr URA appreciation on thin 15 txns
Boutique low-liquidity block; $2.35M quantum for a 2BR-labelled unit is steep
catalysts: East Coast Park and dining belt proximity
